This '''rebel''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] who served the Onderon rebels during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|Where is the false king?''"<br />"''I'll never tell you.|The commando droid demanding the location of the king from the rebel|<ref name="TP" />}}
When Onderon's [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|king]] sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], this rebel fought to gain back its freedom. During the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|battle]], the rebel was stationed at [[The nest/Legends|The nest]] when the base was attacked by an [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP]] and several droids. The rebel was approached by a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]] who demanded the location of the king but the rebel refused to tell, and was subsequently shot in the head.<ref name="TP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rebel was voiced by [[Catherine Taber]], who also voices [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="TP" />
